      Transparent rental price

      The agent offering this property has provided a detailed breakdown of the rental price. This makes it clear what the total rent is (including additional costs such as electricity, internet or service charges), so that you know what to expect. If an agent fills in the total rent price, we call this a transparent rent price.

      We do our utmost to give you clarity about the rent you have to pay. Still have doubts or see a different rent price on the agent's website? Let us know.
